narr: Slow moving thunderstorms produced heavy rain which caused flooding in the western Florida panhandle.
ev: Flash flooding from heavy rain closed Hughes Street between Eglin Parkway and Beal Parkway northeast. High water rescues of three adults and one child from flooded vehicles.
